scenes.say: Most people don't want financial freedom. They want a bigger number.
A bigger number never ends. Every time you reach it, your lifestyle moves the line.
The chase: more money, more spending, a goal that runs away.
The other road: know what enough costs, and freedom shows up years earlier.
Freedom isn't how much you have. It's how little you need to live the life you want.
If you can't name your number, you'll chase it forever.
